implementation.mandatoryDeployment: Dedicated Docker network namespace; startup UID root and container-local NET_ADMIN. The startup policy is installed before the API/browser starts. NET_ADMIN/NET_RAW are removed from the API bounding set; browser UID1000 has zero capabilities and NoNewPrivs. Fixed loopback filter port defaults3004 and must match the running destination filter. Root-owned code/binary; restricted child environment; no unsafe host-mode deployment is supported.
implementation.apiRouting: Existing dynamic owner discovery, distinct-engine/boot and closed-attempt proofs route opt-in fallback to WebKit without an API schema change. The same retained-context HTTP interface works. A heterogeneous alternate list still selects at most one owner, not every engine.
implementation.limits: This adds an optional engine and a bounded network boundary, not hosted parity or an enterprise certification.

pacing.limit: Slot reservation precedes fetch. Observed gaps are retained; configuration is not an exact dispatch floor.

fullApiBenchmark.comparisonLimit: Single-policy fresh run, not a contemporaneous paired Chromium/Firefox or hosted comparison. No new primary-only score is inferred from fallback responses. The historical 46 primary/56 fallback and hosted82 observations remain separately dated evidence.

historicalComparison.limits: Different engine bundle and live epoch; no contemporary matched Chromium/Firefox or hosted run. Five earlier fresh Saks contexts shared one browser owner, not five independent browser boots; no durable site-coverage guarantee.

localWebkitIntegrationCounts.scope: Page/worker scripts and identity; headers/cookies/redirects; retained context isolation/deletion; denial and timeout cleanup; UID/capability proof; allowed HTTP/private rejection; IPv4/IPv6 constructed RTC probes; actual IPv6 same-UID TCP rejection after trusted-UID positive control.

fullApiSnips.command: pnpm harness pnpm exec vitest run src/__tests__/snips/v2/browser-webkit.test.ts
cases: Primary denial recovered on actual WebKit with consent and readiness forwarded.
Opt-out makes no alternate call; unresolved alternate denial remains failure.
fullApiSnips.teardownLimit: The harness command returned0 and all processes terminated, but extract-worker logged IllegalOperationError: Channel closing during teardown. This is not a clean worker-shutdown verification.

singleProfileHarnessRepair.change: Allow1..8 profiles; empty, too many, duplicate and unsafe credential configurations still rejected. No request construction or scoring change.

browserCi.limits: Both jobs passed on the measured source. The ordinary suite skips the two optional WebKit parent tests; the separate mandatory WebKit job runs them, with nine tests including children passing. Broader server/SDK workflows are not verified here.

preflightAndRepairHistory: Initial local launch rejected the old prototype binary because it was owned by UID1000. Local image ownership was repaired; the production Dockerfile already installs WebKit as root.
Two new test expectations were corrected to existing contracts: session DELETE204 and VERIFICATION_REQUIRED. Production behavior was not relaxed.

One thin-image build attempted an unsupported bare image-ID FROM reference. An old-image test invocation followed; its failed test receipt is retained and excluded from final-candidate evidence. The repaired tag-based build and final candidate tests passed.

The initial full100 dispatcher rejected a single profile before any target call. The runner and all three owners terminated; logs prove zero target dispatches. A focused profile-validation repair preceded the completed run.
remainingWork: Classify confirmed WebKit navigation connection-termination errors so the existing bounded fallback can handle them; preserve TLS and arbitrary browser failures.
Investigate the separately observed non-proper TLS termination and page-process crash; do not relabel certificate failures or arbitrary browser errors as retryable network faults.
Reproduce blocked blob-backed resources in owned fixtures and permit valid in-browser resources without weakening top-level target or private-destination checks.
Evaluate subsequent fixes without relabelling this measured runtime or treating the historical hosted82 score as a new comparison.

cleanup.ownershipMethod: Baseline inventories, four exact own build windows with no overlapping build, parent-chain checks and exact cache-ID preview. Only two new obsolete image IDs were audited; both were already absent at cleanup, so no explicit image removal was necessary.

observedImplementationGaps.limit: Saved backend logs establish these observations, not that blob allowance or error normalization will recover any public target. Controlled regressions and a later run are required.

sources.finding: Upstream libsoup3.2.3 emits the observed connection-termination wording when an HTTP/2 read returns EOF. The installed Debian package reports3.2.3-0+deb12u2; this review does not audit every downstream patch.

Blob URLs resolve entries in a browser-maintained store and have origin/storage partition rules. This supports investigating a resource policy repair; it does not authorize network destination bypass.
